hero.label: Made for Surface Labs
hero.headline: I want to be the first SDR who builds Surface Labs' outbound engine.
hero.subheadline: Surface Labs is solving a real problem I watched firsthand at NextAfter: inbound traffic that never converts because the follow-up is too slow or the form loses people before they even submit. I want to be the person on the ground turning that product story into pipeline, before the playbook exists and when it matters most.

whyCompany.title: Inbound conversion is broken and Surface Labs is fixing the right layer
whyCompany.body: Most B2B teams obsess over driving traffic but bleed leads at the form and follow-up stage. Surface Labs attacking that gap with enrichment, fraud prevention, and AI agents is a sharper angle than another landing page tool. That specificity makes it genuinely easier to sell because the pain is real and measurable.

whyCompany.title: Founding GTM hire means the playbook is still being written
whyCompany.body: Being the first SDR at a company like this means the sequences, the ICP targeting, and the messaging framework I build will actually stick around. That is the kind of leverage that does not exist at a 200-person company. I am looking for exactly this moment, not a role where the motion is already figured out.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter background maps directly to this motion
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end to end in HubSpot, built LinkedIn sequences, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch with no brand recognition behind me. At NextAfter I saw how B2B organizations think about converting digital intent into action, which is exactly the conversation Surface Labs needs its SDR to lead with prospects.

quote: I have done this from zero before, no brand, no inbound, just outreach and a product worth believing in. Surface Labs is the first company since then where I looked at the product and thought, I could sell this to anyone in my pipeline tomorrow.
